title: Multicellularity and morphological complexity are driven by greedy infotaxis

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Multicellularity and morphological complexity are driven by greedy infotaxis

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Morphological complexity and multicellularity are proposed to be driven by greedy infotaxis: cells collecting as much information as possible from as far away in space and time as possible to minimize surprise, with greater network connectivity enlarging what the compound individual can sense, remember and store.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: The Computational Boundary of a "Self": Developmental Bioelectricity Drives Multicellularity and Scale-Free Cognition

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2019, The Computational Boundary of a "Self": Developmental Bioelectricity Drives Multicellularity and Scale-Free Cognition › The Agent’s Evolutionary Back-Story: Scaling of Information by Bioelectricity

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: It is proposed that morphological complexity and multicellularity are driven by greedy infotaxis (Vergassola et al., 2007) – collecting as much information as possible, from as far away (in both space and time) as possible, to minimize surprise and optimize prediction.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “The Computational Boundary of a "Self": Developmental Bioelectricity Drives Multicellularity and Scale-Free Cognition”, Frontiers in psychology (2019), doi:10.3389/fpsyg.2019.02688; section “The Agent’s Evolutionary Back-Story: Scaling of Information by Bioelectricity”. Scope: Origin of multicellularity and morphological complexity

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2019-boundary-16: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.29

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Comparative data can evaluate pieces such as sensory and connectivity expansion. They cannot presently establish that surprise-minimizing information collection drove multicellularity and complexity rather than accompanying them.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Across independent origins of multicellularity, quantify information-gathering range and predictive performance before and after transitions and test whether increases precede or predict morphological complexity better than ecological and energetic alternatives.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Greedy infotaxis is not uniquely operationalized at evolutionary scale.

Extant taxa provide biased proxies for ancient transitions.

fields.value:
data adequacy: 0.16
analysis feasibility: 0.28
discriminating power: 0.2
operationalizability: 0.3
data existence: 0.45

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The sentence proposes that morphological complexity and multicellularity were driven by collecting information to minimize surprise. Present-day connectivity and colony form are compatible with many selective advantages. Nothing public encodes the ancestral objective. The claim is a historical interpretation without a distinguishing observation.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Greedy infotaxis is a specific foraging algorithm. The origin of multicellularity would have to be shown to have been driven by that algorithm rather than by other benefits of staying together, and no dataset records the information-gathering objective of those ancestral cells.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Adhesion, feeding, and defense predict multicellularity without infotaxis.

The proposal is a historical driver, not a present-day correlation.
